Package edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo

Class TspAnnealingProblem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspAnnealingProblem
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnnealingProblem<TspSolution>
public final class TspAnnealingProblem extends Object implements AnnealingProblem<TspSolution>
AnnealingProblem adapter that connects the TSP model to the MDI simulated annealing framework.

This class is responsible for three things the framework requires:

  1. Solution generation — randomSolution(java.util.Random) produces a uniformly random permutation of all city indices using a Fisher-Yates shuffle. This is used both for the initial working solution and, during initialization, by the TemperatureHeuristic to sample the energy distribution for T₀ estimation.
  2. Energy evaluation — energy(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) delegates to TspSolution.getTourLength(), which sums edge distances including any river penalty or bonus.
  3. Move generation — randomMove(java.util.Random, edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) returns a reusable TspMove instance. The move object is allocated once and cached; its random parameters are chosen freshly each step inside TspMove.prepare(TspSolution).

Move reuse

Rather than allocating a new TspMove on every call to randomMove(java.util.Random, edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution), this class caches a single instance in cachedMove. This is safe because the framework's inner loop always calls TspMove.prepare(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) before TspMove.deltaE(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) and TspMove.apply(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) or TspMove.undo(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution), so the move is always in a freshly prepared state when used. Eliminating per-step allocation avoids generating millions of short-lived objects and the GC pressure that entails.

Thread safety

This class is not thread-safe. It is owned exclusively by the simulation thread and must not be shared across threads.

    • randomSolution

      public TspSolution randomSolution(Random rng)
      Generate a uniformly random tour by shuffling all city indices.

      Uses a Fisher-Yates shuffle to produce an unbiased random permutation. This method is called by the framework both to create the initial working solution and (repeatedly) during T₀ estimation by the TemperatureHeuristic.

      Specified by:
      randomSolution in interface AnnealingProblem<TspSolution>
      Parameters:
      rng - source of randomness (non-null)
      Returns:
      a new TspSolution with a random tour visiting all cities

    • energy

      public double energy(TspSolution sol)
      Compute the energy (cost) of a solution as its total tour length.

      Delegates to TspSolution.getTourLength(), which sums TspModel.getDistance(int, int) for all consecutive city pairs including the closing edge. River penalties or bonuses are incorporated by the distance function.

      Specified by:
      energy in interface AnnealingProblem<TspSolution>
      Parameters:
      sol - the solution to evaluate (non-null, tour must be initialised)
      Returns:
      total tour length; lower is better

    • randomMove

      public AnnealingMove<TspSolution> randomMove(Random rng, TspSolution current)
      Return a prepared TspMove for the next annealing step.

      Returns the cached move instance, creating it on the first call. The framework calls TspMove.prepare(TspSolution) immediately after this method returns, so the move's random segment parameters are always freshly chosen before TspMove.deltaE(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) or TspMove.apply(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution) is called.

      Specified by:
      randomMove in interface AnnealingProblem<TspSolution>
      Parameters:
      rng - source of randomness passed to the move (non-null)
      current - the current solution (unused here; segment selection happens inside TspMove.prepare(edu.cnu.mdi.sim.simanneal.tspdemo.TspSolution))
      Returns:
      the reusable TspMove instance
